title: U.S. House · Texas's 38th District
area: A Houston-area district covering parts of northwest Harris County.

context.text: This is an open seat under Texas's 2026 congressional map. Rep. Wesley Hunt, the previous incumbent, did not make the general-election ballot for this district (Hunt ran for U.S. Senate). Jon Bonck defeated Shelly deZevallos in the Republican primary runoff.

candidates.name: Melissa McDonough
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 51.6% of the vote
candidates.currentRole: Realtor and brokerage owner; volunteer lobbyist

priorities.text: Calls for restoring constitutional checks and balances among the three branches of government.
priorities.quote: We must restore the constitutional checks and balances between the three branches of government. No branch should dominate another or operate without accountability.

priorities.text: Supports reinstating and strengthening federal agencies including the EPA, USDA, and Department of Education, and fully enforcing the Clean Air and Clean Water Acts.
Says her advocacy work has focused on consumer protection, housing affordability, affordable health care, veterans' services, and agriculture.

positions.summary: On her campaign platform page (footer dated 2024), says Texas should embrace renewable energy innovation while the petroleum industry remains an integral part of its economy.
positions.quote: The petroleum industry will always be an integral part of the Texas economy, but we will be left behind if we do not keep up with advances in energy.

positions.summary: On her campaign platform page (footer dated 2024), says Texas should expand Medicaid.
positions.quote: We should expand Medicaid and make Texas a state where getting sick won’t ruin your life.

positions.summary: On her campaign platform page (footer dated 2024), lists stronger background checks and safe firearm storage among ways to reduce gun violence while respecting the Second Amendment.
positions.quote: By promoting responsible gun ownership, safe firearm storage, stronger background checks, and improved access to mental health care, we can help reduce gun violence while protecting the constitutional rights of law-abiding Texans.

positions.summary: On her campaign platform page (footer dated 2024), criticizes Texas's abortion ban and says women deserve the right to bodily autonomy in their health care decisions.
positions.quote: Women deserve the right to bodily autonomy, and their healthcare decisions should be made privately with a physician.

positions.summary: On her campaign platform page (footer dated 2024), criticizes the Trump administration's trade war with China as costing Americans $80 billion in new taxes.
positions.quote: Donald Trump’s trade war with China cost Americans $80 billion in new taxes

candidates.name: Jon Bonck
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff against Shelly deZevallos, 64.8% to 35.2%
candidates.currentRole: Sales manager, Bonck & Baker Mortgage Group

priorities.quote: Finish the wall. End the invasion. Put Texas first.

priorities.text: Opposes abortion, saying life begins at conception.
priorities.quote: Life begins at conception. No compromise.

priorities.text: Opposes what his campaign describes as curricula addressing gender identity in schools.
priorities.quote: No woke curriculum. No gender ideology. Parents first.

positions.summary: Campaign platform states that life begins at conception, with no compromise.
positions.quote: Life begins at conception. No compromise.

statements.quote: God-given rights don’t need D.C.’s permission.
statements.context: Under the heading 'Protect the Second Amendment' on his campaign site

candidates.researchNotes: Campaign site (jonbonck.com) has a one-line summary per issue and no issue pages; a Community Impact candidate Q&A repeats the same priorities. Only the abortion position and one Second Amendment statement map to the guide's issues. Positions on health care, taxes, housing, tariffs and other issues were not found.

candidates.name: Alex McMenemy
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the Green Party convention on March 14, 2026

priorities.text: Calls for free universal health care, stronger environmental protections, a $20 minimum wage, and stronger labor unions.
priorities.quote: My campaign calls for free universal healthcare, stronger environmental protections to combat climate change, and a $20 minimum wage as well as stronger unions!

priorities.text: Calls for abolishing U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars.
priorities.quote: My campaign calls for the end of ICE, the end to foreign wars, and an end to supplying weapons for war criminals!

priorities.text: Says he is focused on addressing homelessness.
priorities.quote: I care very much for the plight of the homeless.

positions.summary: Calls for free universal health care.
positions.quote: My campaign calls for free universal healthcare

positions.summary: Calls for raising the federal minimum wage to $20 per hour.
positions.quote: a $20 minimum wage as well as stronger unions

positions.summary: Calls for stronger environmental protections to address climate change.
positions.quote: stronger environmental protections to combat climate change

positions.summary: Opposes continued U.S. weapons supplies to Israel, describing the government's actions in Gaza as a genocide of Palestinians.
positions.quote: our government is starting new wars every day or contributing to war crimes like Israel's genocide of the Palestinians. My campaign calls for the end of ICE, the end to foreign wars, and an end to supplying weapons for war criminals!

researchNotes: No biography or background information was found on Ballotpedia for Green Party nominee Alex McMenemy beyond his Candidate Connection survey; his 'israel_aid' position reflects his own campaign statement quoted verbatim, not an independently verified news account. Jon Bonck has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey and his biography rests on a brief Ballotpedia profile; no campaign website or news profile was loaded for him.
